author: resepignev
body:
Some moderators are doing this and I would like to hop on this train :D

Infraction #1 - ID: 617421
Player: resepignev
Infraction: Permanent Ban for "resepignev" (issued by resepignev) (Appealed)
Reason for removal: I was Jr Mod and wanted to test the /ban command. I didn't expected that it works since the Jr Mod permissions aren't including the /ban command. Well, how you see it worked and I instantly reported the unknown bug. It should be removed because it's an invalid infraction and it's already appealed.

Infraction #2 - ID: 102057
Player: schmenni
Infraction: Permanent Ban for "Compromised Account." (issued by TheMasterCow) (Appealed)
Reason for removal: I made a silly joke about how "resepignev" (me) hacked my other account "schmenni". (Yes I said I hacked my own account). Well, somehow there was a misunderstanding and TheMasterCow (Para/Kiesto) thought the account got hacked. the good moderator he is, he banned that account instantly. He told me ingame that the account is banned and I said it was a joke. He told me that these kind of jokes aren't funny (I already realised that as the account got banned) and that he'll ask a senior moderator to appeal the infraction. Well, what I try to say is, it was my fault to make such a joke and I regret it, but I would like to have a clean infractions page on that account.
